questions.solution_text:
A reference angle of $45^{\circ}$ occurs once in each quadrant.
Q1: $45^{\circ}$
Q2: $180^{\circ}-45^{\circ}=135^{\circ}$
Q3: $180^{\circ}+45^{\circ}=225^{\circ}$
Q4: $360^{\circ}-45^{\circ}=315^{\circ}$
$\theta=45^{\circ},135^{\circ},225^{\circ},315^{\circ}$
